short_description: Half-day 5.5-hour VIP-style sightseeing tour of Los Angeles visiting Beverly Hills, Santa Monica Pier, The Grove/Farmers Market, and Griffith Observa​
location_address: 7046 Hollywood Blvd Los Angeles, CA US 90028
description:
Experience the best of Los Angeles in a streamlined half-day VIP-style sightseeing tour. Travel in a new climate-controlled 2025 luxury mini-coach with an entertaining driver guide who shares local stories and fun facts. Visit four convenient stops—Beverly Hills and Rodeo Drive, Santa Monica Pier, The Grove and Farmers Market for lunch, and Griffith Observatory for Hollywood Sign views—while using a free multilingual audio guide available in 11 languages for added context. The tour begins and ends at the Hollywood Visitor Center for easy access to Hollywood highlights.
Your ticket also includes a complimentary self-guided Hollywood Walk of Fame walking tour, and our team will assist you with setup during check-in so you can explore at your own pace.

what_is_included_items.value: Transportation aboard a 2025 climate-controlled luxury mini-coach
Entertaining driver guide providing local commentary and insights
Free multilingual audio guide app with pre-recorded commentary in 11 languages
Stop time at Beverly Hills and Rodeo Drive
Stop time at Santa Monica Pier
Stop time at The Grove and The Farmers Market for lunch and shopping
Stop time at Griffith Observatory for Hollywood Sign views
Self-guided Hollywood Walk of Fame audio walking tour in 11 languages provided at check-in

itinerary:
1. Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive — 30 minutes: Beverly Hills sign and Rodeo Drive sightseeing.
2. Santa Monica Pier — 45 minutes: Walk the pier and ocean views.
3. The Farmers Market & The Grove — 60 minutes: Lunch and shopping time.
4. Griffith Observatory & Hollywood Sign Views — 30 minutes: Panoramic views and photo opportunities.
highlights:
* See LA’s most iconic landmarks in a convenient half-day format
* Travel in brand-new 2025 luxury, climate-controlled coaches
* Multilingual audio guide available in 11 languages for a personalized experience
* Entertaining local driver guide sharing stories and fun facts
* Four curated stops allowing time to explore, eat, and take photos
check_in_details: Meet at the Hollywood Visitor Center, 7044 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028. Please arrive 15 minutes before scheduled departure. Check-in staff will assist with downloading and logging into the audio guide app.

what_to_bring_items.value: Smartphone to download and use the multilingual audio guide app
Comfortable walking shoes for stops and short walks
Weather-appropriate clothing such as a jacket or sun protection

special_requirements: Guests should arrive 15 minutes before departure to ensure timely departure. Check-in staff will assist with app download and login.
restrictions: Inside Griffith Observatory is closed on Mondays; the tour will still visit the exterior and viewpoint. Tour duration is approximate and subject to traffic conditions.
disclaimers: Tour duration is approximately 5.5 hours, subject to traffic. Griffith Observatory interior access may be closed on certain days (closed on Mondays); in that case the tour visits the exterior viewpoint and provides extra time at Beverly Hills. The tour begins and ends at the Hollywood Visitor Center. Guests are advised to review lunch and shopping options at The Grove and Farmers Market to maximize stop time.
